description: This file is a shell script that sets up and runs a series of tests related to Git packfile repacking, delta objects, islands, and object ordering. It defines functions to generate commits, check delta bases, and runs multiple test cases to verify the behavior of Git's repack command with different configurations.

methods.name: is_delta_base
methods.description: Checks whether a given object is a delta base for another object using Git's cat-file batch-check.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Generates a commit with a single file 'file' whose content is based on seed and appended data, creating a blob object and a commit, then updates a ref to point to the new commit.
